text:
mara: FYI saw duplicate charges from payments sample when SDK retried a 429. Two POSTs. Anyone seen this?
ryan: Is payments.create flagged idempotent in sample? SDK only safe-retries idempotent ops by default.
mara: Not flagged. We call `client.payments.create()` with no idempotency header. Server accepted both.
cheng: Confirm whether retries are SDK-level or infra.
sam-qe: QE logs show SDK retried after 429: `WARN retrying status=429 attempt=1` then two outgoing POSTs.
anya: Current SDKs treat 429 as retryable for non-streaming calls — unsafe. We need parity across languages.
ryan: Proposal: SDKs must NOT auto-retry 429s for non-idempotent methods. Provide `idempotencyKey` option or require method metadata `idempotent:true`.
cheng: Optional server hint header `X-Can-Retry: true|false` could help during rollout.
mara: SDK-first change: only retry 429 when Idempotency-Key present or method flagged idempotent. Backoff: exponential with full jitter, limit 5 attempts. For non-idempotent methods return 429 plus `UNSAFE_REPLAY` guidance.
anya: Streaming endpoints are non-idempotent; never auto-retry 429s.
sam-qe: Edge case: auth refresh caused a replay — if token refresh happens mid-request, mark in-flight requests `canReplay=false` to avoid unsafe replays.
ryan: Checklist: add `idempotencyKey` param, set Idempotency-Key header, update samples/docs, publish a small YAML `retry_policy` spec, add e2e tests where server returns 429 then 200 to validate safe replay.
cheng: Node backoff snippet:
```
function jitterDelay(attempt){ const base=100; const cap=3000; const max=Math.min(cap, base*(2**attempt)); return Math.random()*max; }
```
mara: UX: return `UNSAFE_REPLAY` error code when SDK refuses to retry.
ci-bot: CI on branch `devex/replay-guard` ran: 46 passed, 2 flaky.
ryan: I'll open GH issues and assign owners: @anya SDK changes, @cheng shared metadata/spec, @mara samples/docs, @sam-qe e2e tests.
mara: Adding to sprint board and will include migration note for sample users. :thumbsup:
